title: Lilo Floating Tiki Bar on the Ottawa River (Gatineau Pickup)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Climb aboard our Hawaiian-style Tiki Hut and enjoy a relaxing cruise along the beautiful Ottawa River with your family, friends, or coworkers! Whether you’re celebrating a special occasion, enjoying a romantic escape, or bringing a school group for a unique heritage experience, there’s no better way to experience Canada’s capital from the water.

Departures are from the Canadian Museum of History. For operational reasons, all tours return to the Wharf, approximately a 3-minute walk from the Museum.

Prefer to depart from the Ottawa (Ontario) side? Simply send us an email after booking or select one of our Ottawa departure tours.
